title: Cold rebuild: the string calculator
summary: Test-drive the string calculator again from an empty editor.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: Katas are meant to be repeated: the second time you notice the small steps, the third time they are habit. Do the **string calculator** again from an empty editor, red first, with your own tests. The acceptance tests are the same.

steps.title: The string calculator, cold
prompt: Test-drive `public static class StringCalculator` with `public static int Add(string numbers)`:
- `""` is 0; comma-separated numbers are added; newlines also separate;
- negatives throw `ArgumentException` with the message `negatives not allowed: -2, -4`;
Write your own `public class StringCalculatorTests` (at least 6 tests) as you go.
